submitted.rationale: XRD shows bixbyite In2O3 on the In-rich side (Q≈2.15, 2.48, 3.5, 4.11), with its peaks weakening as Sb increases. Rutile InSbO4 (Q≈1.875) appears at ≥~50% Sb. The Q≈2.79, 4.55 and 5.33 peaks are in every pattern and look like they come from the substrate. EQE at 2.7 eV: idx2 (15% Sb) 0.018%, idx9 (28% Sb) 0.039%, idx14 (47% Sb) 0.036%. Idx9, in the Sb-rich bixbyite region before the rutile phase forms, was the highest measured.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.018%, about half of idx9
Measured EQE 0.036%, slightly below idx9; close to where rutile InSbO4 forms
Not measured; InSbO4's wide band gap should absorb poorly at 2.7 eV
